gap: No result ChatGPT got states that Trailcampro's lab measured 70 ft detection range and 1.9 s picture recovery for the Bushnell Core S-4K No Glow (ChatGPT's 'best overall') against 90 ft and 0.6 s for the Browning Dark Ops Pro X 1080, which scored 85/100 overall to the Bushnell's 81/100.
standout_why: Rival pages I compared: TechGearLab (read 2026-11-11, updated 2026-08-18), Outdoor Life's best trail cameras (2026-10-19) and Field & Stream's cellular guide (2026-09-10). TechGearLab tested the Bushnell Core S-4K with a walk test at 10-ft steps and says it triggered consistently to 100 ft by day. It gives only Bushnell's spec of 1.0 s for recovery, and it does not cover the Browning Dark Ops Pro X 1080. Outdoor Life covers the Tactacam Pro 4.0 Solar with a walk test (60 ft yes, 110 ft no) but gives no recovery or transmission time, and it does not cover the Bushnell or the Browning. Field & Stream has no recovery figures. None of the three gives Trailcampro's numbers (detection range and angle, picture recovery, transmission seconds, battery months) side by side. I could not read Wirecutter (proxy returned 403, nytimes blocked), Popular Mechanics (blocked) or Digital Camera World's roundup (truncated), so one of them might have part of this.
decides: It weakens the case for Bushnell as the default 'best overall' over the Browning Dark Ops Pro X 1080, which ChatGPT listed as an aside at nearly the same price ($149.99 vs $149.95 on ChatGPT's cards). In Trailcampro's lab the Browning beats the Bushnell on detection range (90 vs 70 ft), picture recovery (0.6 vs 1.9 s), estimated battery life (27 vs 21.5 months) and overall score (85 vs 81). The two labs disagree on the Bushnell's range: TechGearLab got 100 ft by day, Trailcampro got 70 ft. The page should show both figures with their names, not choose one. For the cellular pick, Trailcampro measured 11.0 s picture recovery on the Tactacam Reveal Pro 4.0 Solar. That backs ChatGPT's advice to use it for remote monitoring rather than for burst coverage of passing animals.
